description: This file defines a SwiftUI View component called StatusPill, which displays a status indicator with various possible gateway states and optional activity information. It manages UI updates and animations based on environment variables and internal state.

classes.name: StatusPill
classes.description: A SwiftUI View component that displays connection status, activity info, and voice wake status with animations and accessibility support.

classes.name: GatewayState
classes.description: An enum representing different connection states with associated UI properties like title and color.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: A struct representing an ongoing activity with title, system image, and optional tint color.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the SwiftUI view hierarchy for the status pill, including layout, conditional subviews, and animations.

methods.name: updatePulse
methods.description: Manages the pulsing animation based on the gateway state, scene activity, and reduce motion setting.

methods.name: accessibilityValue
methods.description: Computes the accessibility label combining gateway state and activity or voice wake status.
